title: Bassac Lane: The Expat Enclave
description: Explore Phnom Penh's Bassac Lane micro-bars and craft cocktail dens after your round at Vattanac Golf Resort on a bespoke Cambodia golf tour with AGS.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Bassac Lane in Phnom Penh offers a curated nightlife experience across a dozen micro-bars, mirroring Tokyo/Melbourne's micro-lane culture, with venues like The Library specializing in bespoke gin and tonics. This 3-hour, low-physical-demand activity is ideal for Friday evenings, attracting diplomats, journalists, and affluent locals.
> * AGS provides luxury SUV transfers and priority reservations for Bassac Lane, ensuring skip-the-line access and a seamless experience. The dress code is smart casual, with some venues requiring closed-toe shoes, and advance booking is strictly required for this year-round offering.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Navigate one narrow alleyway in Phnom Penh containing a dozen distinct, intimately sized micro-bars. It is the sophisticated core of the capital's expat and creative nightlife.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Mirroring the micro-lane culture of Tokyo or Melbourne, Bassac Lane transformed a dusty alleyway into the trendiest coordinate in the city. Each 'hole-in-the-wall' bar operates with a fierce dedication to a specific theme—from rum shacks to high-end gin joints.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Arrive via Tuk Tuk to the entrance of the lane. Spend the evening 'lane-hopping'. You might start with a bespoke gin and tonic at The Library, move to a craft beer spot, and end up eating premium sliders at a gastro-pub. 

The crowd is heavily international, consisting of diplomats, journalists, and affluent locals. The atmosphere is vibrant but remains highly civilized and conversation-driven.

| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Trendy, Social, Micro-Clubs |

| **Physical Demand** | Low (Walking lane) |

## Navigating Phnom Penh’s Boutique Micro-Bar Alley After Vattanac or Chhun On
Tucked off Street 308 in Phnom Penh’s lively Tonle Bassac diplomatic quarter—just 10 minutes south of [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) and [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/)—**Bassac Lane** is the capital’s answer to Melbourne’s laneways and Tokyo’s Golden Gai. After a full morning on the fairways at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/), [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/), or [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/), or straight after a twilight floodlit round on [Vattanac West](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/), Bassac Lane gives touring golf groups half a dozen intimate craft bars within a 100-meter pedestrian walkway.

Because each micro-bar holds only 15 to 30 seats, arriving with a group of 4 to 12 golfers without advance coordination often means standing in the humid lane; our Phnom Penh concierge pre-books sequential booths across the enclave’s standout rooms so your group flows effortlessly from bar to bar.

## Curated Micro-Bar Progression & Concierge Logistics
* **Three-Stop Laneway Progression:** Start with small-batch botanical gin and tonics inside *The Library* or *Harry’s*, transition to smoky mezcal and aged rum pours at *Picasso Bar* or *Cicada*, and wrap up with live acoustic blues or vinyl DJ sets on an upstairs wooden terrace.
* **Standby Luxury Private Touring Vehicle Transfers:** Your luxury private touring vehicle drops your party at the Street 308 entrance at 8:30 PM and remains on call two minutes away for an effortless return to [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) or [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/).

## Pairing Bassac Lane With Phnom Penh’s Championship Golf Rotation
When your itinerary features three rounds across [Vattanac East Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-east/), [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/), [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/), and [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/), Bassac Lane provides the ideal lively contrast to the high-altitude glamour of [Sora Skybar](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-sora-skybar-phnom-penh/) at [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) and the heritage Elephant Bar at [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/). Because the laneway sits just five minutes from Phnom Penh’s premier dining rooms—including *Malis* and *Topaz*—your group can transition effortlessly from a private celebratory banquet into reserved craft-cocktail booths without crossing town.

faqs.q: Where is Bassac Lane located relative to Phnom Penh's luxury hotels and golf courses?
faqs.a: Bassac Lane sits off Street 308 in the Tonle Bassac district of central Phnom Penh—roughly 10 minutes by private SUV from Rosewood Phnom Penh and Raffles Hotel Le Royal, and 40 minutes from Vattanac Golf Resort and Chhun On Golf Resort.

faqs.q: What is the best time of night for a golf group to visit Bassac Lane in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Arriving between 8:00 PM and 9:30 PM on a Thursday, Friday, or Saturday evening lets your group claim reserved seating inside the micro-bars before the late-night diplomatic and expat crowd fills the laneway.

faqs.q: Can Bassac Lane accommodate a golf group of 8 to 12 players?
faqs.a: Because individual micro-bars on Bassac Lane are compact (15–30 seats), Asia Golf Specialists pre-reserves private upstairs terraces or adjacent booths across two or three partner bars so larger golf groups stay together comfortably.
